_comment: Map asset ids to sprite files inside this assets/ folder. The client fetches this manifest, tries to load each sprite, and falls back to a colored placeholder block when the file is missing. Sprite anchor: bottom-center of the item's footprint, drawn on the isometric grid. Avatar bases are full 1024x1024 canvases; the client composites them using the measured anchors in B1-anchors.json / B2-anchors.json (feet_baseline_y, ground_center_x) — never trimmed.
